pdfsharp.finding: PDFsharp exposes the content stream's operators and their raw string operands (font-encoded bytes, here glyph codes), and the font dictionaries as plain dictionaries. No public member maps an operand to Unicode text or gives its position on the page; doing so needs a character-map parser and a text-matrix engine, which is building a reader.
